svg.text: Unit intent — what a unit does NEXT (DESIGN_Unit_Intent.md §5)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app. Context drawn dimmed is unchanged (R-4151).
Intent — what the unit does next
Not started — nothing runs before the first step.
(Running behaviours, Knows, Why … appear once it runs)
A EDIT MODE: the intent IS the unit's starting AI; the save writes it.
The monitoring part has nothing to show until the run starts.
Intent — what the unit does next
Bravo follows a mission plan — edit its first task
Not started — nothing runs before the first step.
B EDIT MODE + PLAN: task row locked (R8 — one source for the task);
SOP and ROE stay editable (plans carry none, R4).
Intent — what the unit does next
This order holds the mission plan (task 3,
Hold at bridge) — resume it on the Orders tab.
When time advances, Attack starts — this staged
edit to Follow route will be lost.
Low level: edits the running memory, staged to the next step.
C PAUSED LIVE: the top EDITS the intent (amber = pending);
below MONITORS what runs now; the chip joins the two.
The blackboard edit is the one low-level edit left (R10).
⚠ two rows halted at once is only for the picture: a plan halts on ONE task.
Edit mode, a file with BOTH a plan and an intent task:
This unit's intent also sets a task (Patrol) — the plan's first task
replaces it; the intent's task never starts.
D ORDERS TAB: Resume plan restarts the held task (R6); Retry is the same command on a fault.
The both-set warning also shows on the Brain tab's intent section.
E The map's order form (live, paused):
Holds Bravo's mission plan — resume it
Edit mode, a planned unit — the menu:
edit its first task on the Orders tab
order items drawn DISABLED; the tooltip says why (R8)
